workshop.livingmarket.status.no_chest: Place a chest/barrel within 3 blocks of workstation
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.fisherman: Fishes at nearby water in the morning and stores the catch in his barrel.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.weaponsmith: Damaged sword/axe + coal in chest → repairs weapon.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.armorer: Damaged armor/shield + coal → repairs gear; repairs Iron Golems in the morning.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.toolsmith: Damaged tool or 2 raw ore + coal → repairs tool / smelts ingots.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.farmer: Harvests nearby beehives into chest; 3 wheat → bread.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.butcher: 2 raw meat + coal → cooked meat; animal feed in chest → breeds nearby livestock.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.shepherd: Shears nearby adult sheep in the morning and stores wool in chest.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.leatherwork: 4 rotten flesh in chest + water in cauldron → 1 leather.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.mason: 4 clay → 4 bricks or 4 cobble → 4 stone bricks; repairs cracked bricks.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.fletcher: 1 stick + 1 flint + 1 feather in chest → 6 arrows.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.cartographe: Torches in chest → lights dark village spots; 8 paper + compass → empty map.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.cleric: Glass bottle + nether wart + glistering melon → Healing Potion; heals at morning service.
workshop.livingmarket.recipe.none: Place a chest or barrel within 3 blocks of a workstation.
